theme.title: Stars and Surprises
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Coming off a rare game without a three, how many did Steph Curry make against New Orleans in November 2016?
questions.note: Curry went from zero made threes against the Lakers to a then-record 13 against New Orleans in his very next game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stephen Curry set a new record of 13 three-pointers made in a single game

funFacts.text: Curry's famous rebound night came immediately after his long made-three streak ended against the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After having his streak of consecutive games with a three-pointer come to an end the previous game

funFacts.text: The superteam season began with a surprisingly heavy home defeat against Kawhi Leonard's Spurs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with a 29-point home loss to the San Antonio Spurs

funFacts.text: Kevin Durant's arrival brought Golden State another superstar alongside Curry, Thompson and Green.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: forming a new All-Star "Fantastic Four" of Kevin Durant, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson and Draymond Green

questions.prompt: Jaylen Brown averaged 20.8 points in his Finals MVP series. What did Shaq average in his 2000 Finals MVP series?
questions.context: 2000 NBA Finals · six games vs Indiana
questions.note: Shaq averaged 38.0 points and 16.7 boards against Indiana. It was the first of his three straight Finals MVPs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: putting up 38.0 points, 16.7 rebounds, and 2.7 blocks per game

funFacts.text: Indiana was making its first NBA Finals appearance, with Larry Bird coaching the Pacers against Los Angeles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This marked Indiana's first NBA Finals appearance

funFacts.text: Shaq swept regular-season MVP, All-Star Game MVP and Finals MVP honors in the same calendar year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: one of only three players to win NBA MVP, NBA All-Star Game MVP and NBA Finals MVP awards in the same year

funFacts.text: The Lakers' victory ended a championship drought stretching back to the Showtime era.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: to win their first NBA championship since 1988 and their twelfth overall

questions.prompt: Oscar Robertson averaged 8.2 assists a game in his title season. What did Jamal Murray average in the 2023 Finals?
questions.note: Murray averaged 10.0 assists beside Jokić. Denver’s biggest scoring threat in the backcourt was also setting the table.

funFacts.text: Murray had torn his ACL before the 2021 playoffs and missed the entire following season while recovering.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jamal Murray, who was crucial to the Nuggets' playoff runs in 2019 and 2020, tore his ACL a month before the start of the 2021 playoffs

funFacts.text: In Game 4 of the Finals, Murray recorded 12 assists without committing a single turnover.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Murray, who committed seven turnovers in game 3, finished the game with 12 assists and zero turnovers

funFacts.text: In Game 1, Murray and Jokić became the first Finals teammates since Magic Johnson and James Worthy to each have 25-plus points and 10 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jokić and Murray also became the second pair of teammates to each put up at least 25 points and 10 assists

questions.prompt: In Milwaukee's 2021 title clincher, how many shots did Giannis block?
questions.note: Five blocks helped deliver Milwaukee's first title in half a century.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 14 rebounds and five blocks

funFacts.text: Milwaukee captured this championship after coming back from a 2–0 Finals deficit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: come back from a 2–0 deficit in the Finals

funFacts.text: The deciding game was tied after the third quarter before Milwaukee pulled away.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: tied at 77 after three quarters

funFacts.text: The Bucks had not won an NBA title since the Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and Oscar Robertson era.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: first championship since 1971

questions.prompt: In Wade's controversial 2006 Finals Game 5, about what percent of his scoring came at the free-throw line?
questions.context: Dwyane Wade · Heat vs Mavericks · 2006 Finals
questions.note: 49%: Wade made 21 free throws while scoring 43, almost half his points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wade finished the game with 43 points while setting an NBA Finals record for most made free throws in a game with 21.

funFacts.text: Wade attempted as many free throws as all of Dallas combined.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dwyane Wade shot 25 free throws—as many as all the Mavericks combined

funFacts.text: Jason Terry led the Mavericks in scoring.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jason Terry led Dallas with 35 points

funFacts.text: Miami needed overtime to escape with the win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dallas Mavericks 100, Miami Heat 101 (OT)
